blocks.html: Thirty three (33) Robinsons Malls are LGU designated vaccination sites. These hubs are offering vaccination jabs for First Dose, Second Dose, Pediatric and Booster, weekdays, from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Schedules are subject to change per LGU advisories. There are seven (7) designated Mall sites in Metro Manila namely: Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Las Pinas, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Novaliches and Forum Robinsons. For Luzon, there are twelve (12) Mall sites: Robinsons Place Dasmarinas, Robinsons Galleria South, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place La Union, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao and Robinsons Place Antipolo. For Visayas and Mindanao there nine (9) sites and five (5) sites, respectively, designated for vaccination: Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Jaro, Robinsons Cybergate Cebu, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons Place Ormoc, Robinsons Place Pavia, Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Cagayan de Oro, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Place Tagum and Robinsons General Santos. For more updates and information, refer to official Robinsons Malls Facebook and IG accounts.
